text.en: 1. This Notification is the CareShield Life and Long‑Term Care (Specified Amount under Section 15(3)) Notification 2020 and comes into operation on 1 October 2020.

heading.en: Specified amount under section 15(3) of Act

text.en: 2. For the purposes of section 15(3) of the Act, the specified amount is $10,000.
